name: Claude
description: Claude is Anthropic's AI assistant, positioned as "the AI for Problem Solvers" — a collaborative thinking partner for writing, coding, research, and analysis that can work with documents, images, and voice.
best_for: Positioned for professionals, developers, students, and researchers who want an AI collaborator for expert-level work across writing, coding, and analysis, plus enterprise teams across healthcare, finance, government, and education needing coordinated project work.
features: Multi-modal input for documents, images, and file uploads
Projects for organizing conversations with persistent context
Integrations with tools like Google Workspace, Jira, and Zapier
API access for developers building on Claude models
Desktop apps for macOS and Windows plus mobile apps and browser extensions

alternatives.name: ChatGPT
alternatives.description: OpenAI's AI assistant offering chat, voice, vision, and agentic "Work"/"Codex" capabilities.
alternatives.best_for: Users wanting one broad assistant across chat, research, documents, and coding.

alternatives.name: Gemini
alternatives.description: Google DeepMind's family of AI models for building and using intelligent agents across text, image, video, and audio.
alternatives.best_for: Users already in the Google ecosystem needing agentic or long-context reasoning.

alternatives.name: Perplexity
alternatives.description: An AI answer engine that researches the open web in real time and returns concise, cited answers.
alternatives.best_for: People who want real-time, cited answers to questions rather than a general-purpose chat partner.
